title: Open-back cup radiating through a rear grille (theory-only example)
description: The same 40 mm driver (Tymphany HPD-40N16PET00-32 primary set, docs/spec-errata.md E5) in an open-back cup. Behind the driver a 5 cm3 space opens through a grille of 50 holes, 1.5 mm in diameter in a 1 mm plate, into the air outside the cup; the grille's outer face radiates as a 20 mm radius opening without a baffle. The free-radiation model is the low-frequency unflanged approximation, so the result flags it above ka = 0.5 (about 1.4 kHz). The front cavity is a two-node depth line closed by a leakier pad than the closed-back example: a 0.15 mm slit whose Poiseuille RC corner with the front cavity is near 50 Hz. The bass barely drops below it, because this compliant diaphragm is force-driven: the front pressure is set by Sd*p = Bl*i until the leak impedance falls below the suspension stiffness reflected through Sd. u_rear_rad is the volume velocity that leaves the grille: multiplied by rho*f/(2r), it gives the monopole bleed estimate of spec Appendix C9 at distance r. Geometry is illustrative; there is no ear model.
